d:
Sony Music Classical presents a beautiful excerpt from Ustad Vilayat Khan Saheb's mesmerizing rendition of the evening Raga Hameer, performed at a concert for Sama Arts Network and Navras Records in 1993 at the iconic Royal Festival Hall, London.
Accompanied by the talented Ustad Sabir Khan on Tabla, this performance showcases the mastery and depth of Ustad Vilayat Khan's artistry, captivating audiences with its emotional resonance.
